attribute_fields.COMMENTS: South Dakota does not impose a state income tax (per sd_has_income_tax=false in SD_edd.xml). The hypothetical progressive-bracket postfix stored here is factually incorrect and slated for removal. NEEDS AUTHORSHIP: existing postfix should be replaced with a no-tax stub; for now the EL DSL sets result.sd_tax = 0 to reflect the actual SD policy.

initial_action.initial_action_dsl: add "SOUTH DAKOTA - no state income tax (sd_has_income_tax=false)" to job.audit_trail; set result.sd_agi = result.agi
initial_action.initial_action_postfix: "SOUTH DAKOTA - no state income tax (sd_has_income_tax=false)" job.audit_trail swap addto result.agi cvi /result.sd_agi xdef

action_details.action_comment: SD tax MFJ - no state income tax in South Dakota (sd_has_income_tax=false)

action_details.action_postfix: 0 cvi /result.sd_tax xdef " South Dakota has no state income tax (MFJ): $0" job.audit_trail swap addto
